program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(size, seps):
        cuts = [-1] + seps + [size]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1) if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]
    row_spans = spans(h, row_seps)
    col_spans = spans(w, col_seps)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            base = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
            marks = sum(v != base for v in cells)
            out_row.append(1 if marks > 1 else base)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''
